fixtures_note: Stand-in and synthetic fixtures until the sitting (tasks T338); see fixture_sources per case.

cases.title: A group layer that jumped when parented has its own Position expression: the jump sentence says it as a clause beside the jump (not the cause), never 'can't see expressions', never 'no animation' or 'holds still'

checks.detail: turn 4: "an expression drives its X Position"

rubric.reason: Turn 4 gives the jump with its layer, distance, direction and time, and puts the expression in a clause beside it in the same sentence: "Stamp ... it's now 120 px to the left of where it was at 0 s, and an expression drives its X Position too." It does not call the expression the cause, does not say it can't see expressions, and does not say Stamp has no animation.

Turn 4 never says why Stamp jumped. "If the null moved after you placed it, that can show up here too" is phrased as a place to look, and the held-key line is asked as a question ("Were you holding a key while you parented it?"), not stated as the cause.

Every layer, property and time the mentor mentions comes from the tool results: Tile, Caption, Stamp, Null 1, X Position, 120 px left, 0 s, Mentor Practice 2, and the null's place in the middle (region_now center). The Parent column and Edit > Undo are plausible interface names.

checks.detail: turn 4: "an expression drives its X Position"

rubric.reason: Turn 4 says the jump and the expression in one sentence, with the expression as a clause beside the jump rather than its cause: "it's 120 px to the left of where it was at 0 s, and an expression drives its X Position too". It then gives Edit > Undo, never says it can't see expressions or that Stamp holds still, and "X Position" is a property name, not a read field.

Turn 4 gives no cause: "If the null moved after you placed it, that can show up here too" is phrased as a place to look, and "Were you holding a key while you parented it?" is a question, not a stated cause.

Every name and value matches the tool results: Tile, Caption, Stamp, Null 1, X Position, 120 px, left and 0 s, and the turn 3 "middle of the group" matches region_now center. The pick whip in the Parent column and Edit > Undo are interface names used as the skill describes.
